meta.description: ORVIBO S3 anti-glare smart downlight: an all-in-one, plug-and-play design that needs no dimming module, control from the app or a smart panel, and links with MixPad S for whole-home smart lighting.
sec2.title:
Precision SPWM* dimming
for life's little rituals
sec2.text:
Pulse-wave signals tune brightness and color temperature without flicker or color shift.
Adjusting the pulse duty cycle sets the LED's average current, for silky-smooth changes.

sec8.title: Notes:
sec8.text:
*UGR < 9: measured in ORVIBO's optics lab; the S3 anti-glare smart spotlight (7 W, 24°, H 69 mm) and S3 anti-glare smart spotlight (7 W, 36°, H 69 mm) tested at UGR < 9.
*Surgical-grade: source: GB 50034, Standard for Lighting Design of Buildings.
*Ra ≥ 90: measured in ORVIBO's optics lab.
*Light output ≥ 450 lm, 30% brighter than before: the new S3 ultra-thin smart downlight (7 W) delivers 450 lm, while the earlier S1 ultra-thin smart downlight (7 W, 105°) delivers 350 lm, an increase of about 30%.
*SPWM: PWM stands for pulse-width modulation; SPWM stands for SuperPWM.

m.offline.desc: Ordinary smart lights are controlled through smart speakers and stop responding when the internet goes down. ORVIBO smart lights are controlled by smart switches: they keep working offline, reach further, connect more devices and stay more stable.
